clipboardSync.title: Clipboard sync
clipboardSync.simpleDescription: Copy on one device. Paste on another.
clipboardSync.textSummary: Share new text copies with your devices.
clipboardSync.addDeviceFirst: Add a device to start sharing.
clipboardSync.networkWarning: Cannot reach your paired devices. Check that they are awake, on the same network, and have syncing enabled. Some public or guest Wi-Fi networks block communication between devices; try a private Wi-Fi network or personal hotspot.
clipboardSync.noDevicesHint: Add your phone or computer with a QR code. Keep both on the same network.
clipboardSync.clipboardHelp: Clipboard access was interrupted. Try copying again. If this continues, turn sharing off and on, then check the connection details.
clipboardSync.helpBasics: Pair devices you trust, then turn on clipboard sharing on both. New copies are shared automatically while both devices are on the same network.
clipboardSync.helpImages: Turn on image sharing on both devices to include copied photos. On Android, it also shares newly saved screenshots from the standard screenshot albums after you allow full photo access. Images can be up to 8 MiB and 16 megapixels. Received images stay available to paste for five minutes.
clipboardSync.helpPrivacy: Only paired devices can share your clipboard. Old copies and older screenshots are not sent when sharing starts. Text or screenshots can contain private information, so only pair devices you control. Clipboard items marked sensitive are skipped.
clipboardSync.helpAndroid: Android uses Shizuku to read copies made in other apps. Start Shizuku, then use Android permissions in the More menu to allow clipboard access and, for screenshots, full photo access.
clipboardSync.shizukuNotFound: No compatible Shizuku app was found. Open your Shizuku version manually, start it, then return here and tap Set up access again.
clipboardSync.shizukuHelp: Open Shizuku and start it, then return here to allow clipboard access.
clipboardSync.photoHelp: Allow full photo access to share new screenshots automatically. Copied images can still be shared.
clipboardSync.accessHelp: Allow the Android permissions needed to share your clipboard.
clipboardSync.imageLimitHelp: This image could not be shared. Try a smaller image (up to 8 MiB and 16 megapixels).
clipboardSync.settingsHelp: Clipboard settings could not be loaded or saved. Restart LocalSend and check the connection details if this continues.
clipboardSync.connectionHelp: Sharing was interrupted. Check that both devices are on the same network and have clipboard sharing turned on. Connection details can help identify the problem.
clipboardSync.description: Automatically share new clipboard copies with explicitly paired devices on your local network.
clipboardSync.imageArrivedBody: Image received from {device}. Ready to paste.
clipboardSync.syncImagesDescription: Enable on both devices to share copied images and new Android screenshots automatically. Android needs full photo access for screenshots in the standard screenshot albums. Images are converted to PNG (up to 8 MiB and 16 megapixels). Received images remain available to paste for five minutes. Sensitive-marked clipboard images are skipped.
clipboardSync.consent: New unmarked text copies, including passwords or other private text, can be shared with your paired devices. When image sync is enabled, copied images and newly saved Android screenshots are also shared. Sensitive-marked and unsupported clips are skipped. Existing clipboard content and old screenshots are not sent when you enable sync. Only pair devices you control and trust.
clipboardSync.codeInstructions: Copy this public code directly to your other device. Add each device’s code on the other, verify the identity, then enable sync on both. Choose reachable addresses on the same network.
clipboardSync.copyFailed: Could not copy pairing code. Try again.
clipboardSync.qrInstructions: On your phone, open Add device and scan this QR code. Keep both devices on the same network.
clipboardSync.nearbyInstructions: Or select a nearby device below to send a pairing request. Keep LocalSend open on the other device.
clipboardSync.noNearby: No devices found yet. Open LocalSend on your other device and refresh.
clipboardSync.requestDescription: Accept only if you are connecting these devices. The other device must enter the code displayed here. Successful pairing turns on clipboard and copied-image sharing on both devices.
clipboardSync.displayCodeTitle: Enter this code on the other device
clipboardSync.displayCodeInstructions: Type this code on the device you want to pair. Share it only with someone you want to give access to your clipboard.
clipboardSync.codeExpiry: This code expires with the pairing request and allows three attempts.
clipboardSync.enterCodeInstructions: On the device you selected, accept the pairing request and read its 8-digit code. Enter that code here to pair and turn on clipboard and copied-image sharing on both devices.
clipboardSync.incorrectCode: Incorrect code. Check the other device and try again.
clipboardSync.waitingForAcceptance: Waiting for the other device to accept...
clipboardSync.verifyInstructions: Compare the code shown on both devices. Confirm only if they match and this is the device you want to pair.
clipboardSync.waitingApproval: Waiting for the other device to confirm…
clipboardSync.pairedInstructions: Pairing is saved. Clipboard and copied-image sharing are turned on automatically on both devices. Allow any requested permissions to start sharing.
clipboardSync.pairingFailed: Pairing could not finish. Keep LocalSend open on both devices, check the network and firewall, and try again. Both devices need a version that supports code entry.
clipboardSync.pairingExpired: This pairing invitation expired. Create a new one to try again.
clipboardSync.pending: Pairing incomplete — remove and pair again
clipboardSync.scanPrompt: Scan the QR code shown in LocalSend’s Add device screen
clipboardSync.verified: I checked this identity directly on the other device and authorize sending and receiving clipboard text
clipboardSync.send: Send my clipboard to this device
clipboardSync.removeMessage: Remove {device}? Clipboard sharing with this device will stop. You’ll need to pair it again to reconnect.
clipboardSync.invalidCode: Invalid or duplicate pairing code. Copy the complete code from the other device.
clipboardSync.limitations: Windows–Android development build: direct LAN sync, with text up to 64 KiB and optional copied images up to 8 MiB / 16 megapixels. Android needs ADB-mode Shizuku on Android 13–16; some apps may not grant access to their copied images. Locked-screen capture and uninterrupted operation during sleep are not guaranteed. Re-pair if a saved IP address changes. Hosted relay and Linux integration are still pending.
clipboardSync.setupDescription: To share copies made in other apps, install Shizuku and keep it running. LocalSend will also ask for clipboard access and notification permission. The tutorial walks you through setup and connecting your devices.
clipboardSync.tutorialIntro: Follow these steps on your Android phone. You only need to pair Shizuku once; start it again after restarting your phone.
clipboardSync.installBody: Get Shizuku from its official website and open it. This build uses its wireless debugging or computer startup mode.
clipboardSync.startBody: Connect to Wi-Fi. In phone Settings, enable Developer options and USB debugging, then enable Wireless debugging. In Shizuku, tap Pairing. In Wireless debugging, choose Pair device with pairing code and enter that code in the Shizuku notification. Return to Shizuku and tap Start. Check that it says it is running. Menu names may vary by phone.
clipboardSync.permissionsBody: Return to LocalSend and allow Shizuku access for LocalSend and notifications. If you want automatic screenshots, turn on Synchronize copied images and allow full photo access.
clipboardSync.accessGranted: Clipboard access is allowed. You can now connect your devices.
clipboardSync.pairBody: Keep both devices on the same network. On your computer, open Clipboard sync and tap Add device. Scan its QR code with your phone camera or LocalSend, or select the computer from Nearby devices. Accept the request on the computer, then enter the code it displays on your phone.
clipboardSync.shareBody: Turn on Share clipboard on both devices. A green dot beside a device means it is connected. Copy something new on one device, then paste on the other. Enable image sharing on both devices for photos and screenshots.
clipboardSync.restartReminder: After restarting your phone, start Shizuku again. If sharing pauses, check Shizuku and that both devices are on the same network.
clipboardSync.openLinkFailed: Could not open the link. Try again.

troubleshootPage.title: Troubleshoot
troubleshootPage.subTitle: Does the app not work as expected? Here you can find some common solutions to problems.

firewall.symptom: This device can send files to other devices but other devices cannot send files to this device.
firewall.solution: This is most likely a firewall issue. You can solve this by allowing incoming connections (UDP and TCP) on port {port}.

noDiscovery.symptom: This device cannot discover other devices.
noDiscovery.solution: Please make sure that all devices are on the same Wi-Fi network and share the same configuration (port, multicast address, encryption). You can try to type the IP address of the target device manually. If this works, consider adding this device to the favorites so it can be automatically discovered in the future.

noConnection.symptom: Both devices cannot discover each other nor can they share files.
noConnection.solution: Does the problem exist on both sides? If so, you need to make sure that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network and share the same configuration (port, multicast address, encryption). The Wi-Fi network may not allow communication between participants due to Access Point (AP) Isolation. In this case, this option must be disabled on the router.

aboutPage.title: About LocalSend
description: LocalSend is a free, open-source app that allows you to securely share files and messages with nearby devices over your local network without needing an internet connection.
This app is available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. You can find all download options on the official homepage.
aboutPage.author: Author

donationPage.title: Donate
donationPage.info: LocalSend is free, open-source and without any ads. If you like the app, you can support the development with a donation.

changes: Encryption no longer slows down transfers. It has been re-enabled on this device if you turned it off before.
Requests from favorites are now accepted automatically. This is turned on by default and can be disabled in the settings.
On Android, transfers continue while the app is in the background or the screen is off. On iOS, the app must still stay in the foreground.
